quotes.title: Kepler-37
quotes.card: Kepler-37, also known as UGA-1785, is a G-type main-sequence star located in the constellation Lyra 209 light-years from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It is host to exoplanets Kepler-37b, Kepler-37c, Kepler-37d and possibly Kepler-37e, all of which orbit very close to it.

notes: Kepler-37 e: Weiss et al. 2024's mass 0.02548545 Jupiter masses in 0.03300925 Jupiter radii is 878.7 g/cm^3, outside what the records accept
